chunks.content: Tool calling is a multi-step conversation between an application and a model. The model returns a tool call, the application executes the function, and the application sends the tool output back to the model.
Prompt injection changes model behavior through crafted input. Indirect prompt injection can arrive through external content such as websites or files that an application processes.
An embedding is a vector representation of data that preserves aspects of meaning. Similar text tends to have embeddings that are closer together, which supports semantic search.
A request method is idempotent when multiple identical requests have the same intended effect as one request. Responses and incidental server records can still differ.
A checkpoint captures consistent application state so processing can recover after failure. Periodic checkpoints allow stateful processing to resume without starting the entire computation again.
Observability uses telemetry such as traces, metrics, and logs to understand system behavior. Correlating these signals helps engineers follow requests and diagnose failures.
